propositions: When REBAR_TRACKER_DIR points outside the code worktree, close_precheck derives code_root as os.path.dirname(tracker) instead of the actual repository root, causing git log to scan the wrong directory.
The misrouted code_root prevents _referencing_commits from finding valid trailer commits in the current worktree HEAD, falsely rejecting close operations.
Completion-gate configuration is derived from the same incorrect code_root, either falsely rejecting valid closes or silently bypassing gate checks depending on tracker-parent file state.
The fix must resolve code_root through config.repo_root(repo_root) for git scanning and gate config while keeping tracker reads independent via config.tracker_dir(repo_root).
Default in-repo tracker behavior and true missing-commit detection must remain unchanged after the fix.
A regression test with separate code worktree and custom tracker directory must fail before the fix and pass after correcting the code-root derivation.
